\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 311-314 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R319-first-pass-words-from-chapters-311-314}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for arrogance and strict.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to stroke, to tidy away, to pull down, to bear fruit, to spread
  \item a disease, a patient, a nurse, an injection, an ambulance
  \item a hiccup, a yawn, an ointment, a herbal decoction, a pregnant woman
  \item a century, a decade, a calendar, long ago, at dawn
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To stroke? (\textbf{\ml{തലോടുക}}, \emph{talōṭuka}.) To tidy away? (\textbf{\ml{ഒതുക്കുക}}, \emph{otukkuka}.) To pull down? (\textbf{\ml{പൊളിക്കുക}}, \emph{poḷikkuka}.) To bear fruit? (\textbf{\ml{കായ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{kāykkuka}.) To spread? (\textbf{\ml{പടരുക}}, \emph{paṭaruka}.) A disease? (\textbf{\ml{രോഗം}}, \emph{rōgaṁ}.) A patient? (\textbf{\ml{രോഗി}}, \emph{rōgi}.) A nurse? (\textbf{\ml{നഴ്സ്}}, \emph{naḻsŭ}.) An injection? (\textbf{\ml{കുത്തിവയ്പ്പ്}}, \emph{kuttivayppŭ}.) An ambulance? (\textbf{\ml{ആംബുലൻസ്}}, \emph{āmbulansŭ}.) A hiccup? (\textbf{\ml{എക്കിൾ}}, \emph{ekkiḷ}.) A yawn? (\textbf{\ml{കോട്ടുവാ}}, \emph{kōṭṭuvā}.) An ointment? (\textbf{\ml{ലേപനം}}, \emph{lēpanaṁ}.) A herbal decoction? (\textbf{\ml{കഷായം}}, \emph{kaṣāyaṁ}.) A pregnant woman? (\textbf{\ml{ഗർഭിണി}}, \emph{garbhiṇi}.) A century? (\textbf{\ml{നൂറ്റാണ്ട്}}, \emph{nūṟṟāṇṭŭ}.) A decade? (\textbf{\ml{പതിറ്റാണ്ട്}}, \emph{patiṟṟāṇṭŭ}.) A calendar? (\textbf{\ml{കലണ്ടർ}}, \emph{kalaṇṭar}.) Long ago? (\textbf{\ml{പണ്ട്}}, \emph{paṇṭŭ}.) At dawn? (\textbf{\ml{പുലർച്ചെ}}, \emph{pularcce}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 315-319 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R319-second-pass-words-from-chapters-315-319}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a state and abroad.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a state, abroad, a place, a direction, north
  \item the earth, nature, a border, a village council, the countryside
  \item alone, anyway, for no reason, not at all, barely
  \item failure, evidence, a thought, a memory, a suggestion
  \item online, humility, character, arrogance, strict
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A state? (\textbf{\ml{സംസ്ഥാനം}}, \emph{saṁsthānaṁ}.) Abroad? (\textbf{\ml{വിദേശം}}, \emph{vidēśaṁ}.) A place? (\textbf{\ml{സ്ഥലം}}, \emph{sthalaṁ}.) A direction? (\textbf{\ml{ദിശ}}, \emph{diśa}.) North? (\textbf{\ml{വടക്ക്}}, \emph{vaṭakkŭ}.) The earth? (\textbf{\ml{ഭൂമി}}, \emph{bhūmi}.) Nature? (\textbf{\ml{പ്രകൃതി}}, \emph{prakṛti}.) A border? (\textbf{\ml{അതിർത്തി}}, \emph{atirtti}.) A village council? (\textbf{\ml{പഞ്ചായത്ത്}}, \emph{pañcāyattŭ}.) The countryside? (\textbf{\ml{നാട്ടിൻപുറം}}, \emph{nāṭṭinpuṟaṁ}.) Alone? (\textbf{\ml{തനിയെ}}, \emph{taniye}.) Anyway? (\textbf{\ml{എന്തായാലും}}, \emph{entāyāluṁ}.) For no reason? (\textbf{\ml{വെറുതെ}}, \emph{veṟute}.) Not at all? (\textbf{\ml{ഒട്ടും}}, \emph{oṭṭuṁ}.) Barely? (\textbf{\ml{കഷ്ടിച്ച്}}, \emph{kaṣṭiccŭ}.) Failure? (\textbf{\ml{പരാജയം}}, \emph{parājayaṁ}.) Evidence? (\textbf{\ml{തെളിവ്}}, \emph{teḷivŭ}.) A thought? (\textbf{\ml{വിചാരം}}, \emph{vicāraṁ}.) A memory? (\textbf{\ml{ഓർമ്മ}}, \emph{ōrmma}.) A suggestion? (\textbf{\ml{നിർദ്ദേശം}}, \emph{nirddēśaṁ}.) Online? (\textbf{\ml{ഓൺലൈൻ}}, \emph{ōṇlain}.) Humility? (\textbf{\ml{വിനയം}}, \emph{vinayaṁ}.) Character? (\textbf{\ml{സ്വഭാവം}}, \emph{svabhāvaṁ}.) Arrogance? (\textbf{\ml{അഹങ്കാരം}}, \emph{ahaṅkāraṁ}.) Strict? (\textbf{\ml{കർശനമായ}}, \emph{karśanamāya}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
